description: We are Team ZYRAX, a group of passionate and innovative tech enthusiasts driven by curiosity, creativity, and problem-solving. We aim to transform real-world challenges into impactful solutions using AI, machine learning, data science, and emerging technologies. We believe in collaboration, experimentation, and building technology that makes a difference. We welcome motivated individuals with skills in AI/ML, software development, data analytics, UI/UX, and creative problem-solving.
